record.title_md: [Informal Conjecture on Universal N0 for Bumping a Ladder](https://arxiv.org/abs/2002.00496)

dossier_meta.catalog_title: Informal Conjecture on Universal N0 for Bumping a Ladder
dossier_meta.statement_text: There exists a constant $N_0$ such that for every $k$, Theorem 2 holds with $N = N_0$. For all we know, this might even be true with $N_0 = 4$.
dossier_meta.context_text: Theorem 2 (Bumping a ladder) asserts that every 3-connected graph containing a union of $N$ vertex-disjoint copies of $L_k$ as a minor contains $L_{k+1}$ as a minor, but the value of $N$ a priori depends on $k$. The authors remark that while 3-connectivity is necessary (see Figure 1), they believe the dependence of $N$ on $k$ is not.
